events.ticker_label: 🪖 European leaders present united front in push for peace in Ukraine

events.title: Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin have held trilateral talks ― but what did they achieve?
events.description: The presidents of China, the US and Russia have held an unprecedented summit. While Trump said the three leaders were "making history," Xi described the talks as "fruitful" and Putin called them "open and candid."

events.title: Anthropic trading tests investors' appetite for AI
events.description: Anthropic was valued at $2 trillion after shares started trading on the Nasdaq following a record $81 billion IPO. Its performance will put investor confidence in AI to the test.

events.title: Pakistan minister to visit India, but no breakthrough expected
events.description: A Pakistani minister's visit to India for a Shanghai Cooperation Organization forum marks a rare high-level contact between the two archrivals, but analysts say it does not signal a resumption of bilateral engagement.

events.title: FIFA: Infantino, Tashima and Diallo enter presidential race
events.description: Three candidates have officially submitted their bids for the FIFA presidency. Gianni Infantino, who has been in office for 11 years, is seeking a fourth consecutive term. Backed by UEFA, French Football Federation president Philippe Diallo wants to offer an alternative to Infantino’s leadership. He will face Japan’s Kohzo Tashima, honorary president of the Japan Football Association. The election will take place on March 18, 2027 in Rabat, Morocco.

events.title: EU and UK set to sign deals on trade, energy, youth mobility at Brussels summit
events.description: The UK and the EU are poised to agree new deals on trade, energy and youth mobility at a summit in Brussels on Friday, as part of UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham's bid to reset ties with the bloc. Burnham – who has said he hopes to see Britain rejoin the EU in his lifetime – argues the deals will help fix some of the damage Brexit inflicted.

events.title: Anthropic goes public after blockbuster IPO but fails to revive AI trade
events.description: Anthropic has become the first pure-play AI developer to be publicly traded on the stock market, following a record-setting IPO. The stock opened 34% higher, briefly valuing the company at more than $2 trillion, before ending its first day of trading up 17%. However, Wall Street indexes closed sharply lower as investors took profits, reflecting underlying market jitters about the AI trade.

events.title: French far-left candidate Mélenchon opens door to alliance with rival Greens candidate
events.description: French far-left leader Jean-Luc Mélenchon opened the door to an alliance with France's Greens on Thursday after their presidential candidate Marine Tondelier said she was ready to "work on a coalition around" the veteran leftist. Tondelier's overture has further boosted Mélenchon's campaign for the Élysée Palace – and angered moderates on the centre-left.

events.title: Macron urges Ukraine's allies to 'reopen the question' of NATO membership
events.description: French President Emmanuel Macron on Thursday called for Ukraine's allies to speed up the delivery of urgently needed air defence systems and urged them to "reopen the question" of Ukraine's NATO membership after talks in Berlin aimed at reaffirming European support for Kyiv.

events.title: A president among body bags: Photo ops spark outrage in Colombia
events.description: Since taking office in August, Colombia's far-right President Abelardo de la Espriella has regularly posted videos that show him walking among body bags supposedly holding the remains of rebel fighters – a communications strategy that has sparked widespread criticism.

events.title: UK conducting offensive cyber ops against Russia, China, Iran and North Korea, says top commander
events.description: The UK is conducting offensive cyber operations against Russia, China, Iran and North Korea, a top military commander has for the first time revealed.
events.ticker_label: 🪖 UK conducting offensive cyber ops against Russia, China, Iran and North Korea, says top commander

events.title: Thomas Markle fit to stand trial over child abuse images, US court rules
events.description: Thomas Markle is fit to stand trial on charges of possessing child sexual abuse material, a US court has ruled.

events.title: England handed suspended away ticket ban for fans' chants during Spain win
events.description: England have been given a suspended away ticket ban by UEFA for "racist and/or discriminatory behaviour" by their fans during a match with Spain in Madrid on Sunday.

events.title: Rohingya in Bangladesh welcome UN court's genocide verdict but say they want to go home to Myanmar
events.description: Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh have welcomed the ruling by the United Nations' top court in the Netherlands that held Myanmar responsible for genocide

events.title: Brazil's Lula moves to protect Chief Raoni’s birthplace in the Amazon rainforest
events.description: The Brazilian government has advanced legal protection for the territory of Raoni Metuktire, a prominent Indigenous leader in the Amazon

events.title: A long-buried ancient library in Rome opens to the public after restoration
events.description: The ancient Ulpia Library in Rome has been restored and is reopening to the public this week
events.ticker_label: 💥 A long-buried ancient library in Rome opens to the public after restoration

events.title: US deportees in South Sudan went hungry as guards pocketed money from relatives, families say
events.description: Migrants deported by the Trump administration to countries other than their own have endured hunger, thirst and other deprivations

events.title: Newborn dies after suspected female genital mutilation in Senegal; relatives arrested
events.description: Three people have been arrested in eastern Senegal after a newborn baby girl died following alleged female genital mutilation
events.ticker_label: 💥 Newborn dies after suspected female genital mutilation in Senegal; relatives arrested

events.title: 4 men found guilty of sex crimes against British woman in a case that recalls Gisèle Pelicot's
events.description: Four British men have been found guilty of multiple sexual crimes against a woman whose ex-husband drugged and advertised her for sex online

events.title: University lecturer from Serbia's student-led movement is elected Parliament speaker
events.description: A university lecturer from Serbia's student-led movement has become Parliament speaker

events.title: Funding cuts raise risks of trafficking and exploitation for refugee children
events.description: Sharp reductions in humanitarian funding are putting refugees, particularly children, at increased risk of being trafficked, exploited or abused, while the systems that protect them are weakening.

events.title: Guterres calls for a legally binding instrument for ‘killer robots'
events.description: Talks began in Geneva on Monday to push for controls on lethal autonomous weapons systems that are often referred to as “killer robots”.

events.title: Texas inmate's execution takes over an hour as prison staff struggle to find suitable veins
events.description: Texas inmate Reinaldo Dennes repeatedly cried out in pain as prison staff struggled for over an hour to establish IV access for his lethal injection.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Texas inmate's execution takes over an hour as prison staff struggle to find suitable veins

events.title: Texas woman broke into home and took a shower, had meth and other drugs in car: sheriff
events.description: Stella Lynn Baker allegedly was found in a stranger's shower in Trinity County, Texas, after deputies say she spun circles in a pasture.

events.title: MICHAEL RUIZ: Lindsay Clancy scores 'little win,' but appeal could 'unravel' future trials, retired judge says
events.description: Lindsay Clancy heads to the Supreme Judicial Court Thursday with her double jeopardy appeal before jury selection in her March retrial begins.

events.title: Florida DMV worker faces 360 felonies for allegedly helping illegal aliens get licenses without driving tests
events.description: Investigators say Lynnette Stitt Williams accepted fake utility bills and skipped driving tests to push 60 licenses through Pembroke Pines office.

events.title: Brother of slain surfing legend never lost hope as 9-month hunt rode wave of clues to Costa Rican ex-lover
events.description: Peter Van Dyke says he never gave up hope for justice after his brother, surfer Kurt Van Dyke, was murdered in Costa Rica as his ex-girlfriend faces arrest.

events.title: Florida pastor convicted in Haitian president's assassination plot funded partly by US COVID relief money
events.description: Christian Emmanuel Sanon was convicted in the plot to kill Haitian President Jovenel Moïse, a scheme prosecutors say was hatched in South Florida.

events.title: ‘Looksmaxxing’ influencer ‘Clavicular’ allegedly told teen to lie about age, call vodka ‘water’ before assault
events.description: Looksmaxxing influencer Braden Peters, known as "Clavicular," faces Massachusetts rape charges after a woman says he gave her alcohol when she was 17.

events.title: Bukele gets hero’s welcome from afar as thousands rally in Haiti after gang crackdown
events.description: Thousands marched in Haiti to thank Nayib Bukele for sending troops to battle violent gangs, prompting an emotional response from the Salvadoran president.
